jobs.prompt: Three small fixes. (1) tools/security-gate.mjs line about 69 and 259-262: the local LIFECYCLE list omits preprepare and postprepare although tools/dependency-diff.mjs lists them; a package.json that adds postprepare with a download-and-run command raises no install-script block. Remove the duplicate list: export the single lifecycle list from tools/dependency-diff.mjs (it is already shared in spirit) and import it in security-gate.mjs so both use ONE list that includes preinstall, install, postinstall, prepare, preprepare, postprepare, prepack, postpack, prepublish, prepublishOnly, preuninstall, uninstall, postuninstall. Test in tests/lifecycle-list-shared.test.mjs: each name adds an install-script block when added or changed in package.json through runSecurityGate, and the two modules export or use the same array. (2) tools/swarm/core-71.mjs about 279-286: when the final full check fails and every job is already integrated, integrationStatus becomes partial but queueIntegrationIncomplete (about 220-225) returns false because queueIntegrationComplete is true, so a run could re-enter integrate with nothing left to merge: make queueIntegrationIncomplete true whenever integrationStatus is partial or failed-check, and make the autopilot treat a partial integrate result (status partial even without integrationStatus, tools/autopilot.mjs about 615) as not complete. recordQueuePass must not throw when both mergeQueue and state.mergeQueue are undefined (treat as empty). Tests in the same new test file. (3) tests/update-when-idle.test.mjs test held launcher waits while pending exists and continues after is flaky under full-suite load (it waits a fixed 30 ms for the waiting line, then asserts it): poll for the waiting line with a 5 second deadline (check every 10 ms) before asserting and before removing the pending record; keep the intent. Run tests/lifecycle-list-shared.test.mjs tests/update-when-idle.test.mjs tests/b7-review-fixes.test.mjs tests/dependency-diff.test.mjs tests/integrate-partial-retry.test.mjs tests/autopilot-readonly-runs.test.mjs tests/autopilot-retry-duplicates.test.mjs tests/autopilot-quiet-poll.test.mjs and every test file with security-gate or queue in the name. ignoreTests reason: only the named files and their tests change.
